## Notes

### Multi-file Shader Groups
Shaders with multiple `.ogl` files need to be consolidated into a single `.glsl` directory structure:
```
ShaderName.glsl/
└── src/
    ├── __init__.glsl      # Main entry point
    ├── A.glsl             # Additional render pass (if applicable)
    ├── B.glsl             # Additional render pass (if applicable)
    └── shared.glsl        # Shared utilities (if applicable)
```
